actions.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on Energy and Mineral Resources.
Referred to the House Committee on Natural Resources.

dimensions.assessment: Affects project sponsors, developers, and federal permitting agencies involved with infrastructure projects valued between $50 million and $200 million.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title XLI of the FAST Act to lower the cost estimate threshold relating to eligibility of infrastructure projects for certain permitting processes

dimensions.assessment: Modifies project eligibility criteria for fast-track permitting, altering administrative review processes for a broader category of mid-sized infrastructure projects.
dimensions.evidence: Section 41001(6)(A)(i)(II) of the FAST Act (42 U.S.C. 4370m note) is amended by striking '$200,000,000' and inserting '$50,000,000'.

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state or imply specific federal spending changes, appropriations, or revenue impacts.
Amends specific statutory definitions and procedural sections under title XLI of the FAST Act to change the monetary threshold for covered projects.
dimensions.evidence: Section 41003(f)(1)(A) of the FAST Act (42 U.S.C. 4370m-2) is amended by striking '$200,000,000' and inserting '$50,000,000'.

dimensions.assessment: Implements a permanent statutory threshold change taking effect on January 1, 2027, or upon enactment, affecting future infrastructure projects indefinitely.
dimensions.evidence: This Act shall take effect on January 1, 2027, or on the date of enactment, whichever is later.

missing_information: Exact number of additional infrastructure projects newly eligible under the lower threshold
Cost savings or administrative time reductions resulting from the threshold change
importance_detail.rationale: The bill lowers the cost estimate threshold for infrastructure projects under title XLI of the FAST Act from $200,000,000 to $50,000,000, expanding eligibility for certain federal permitting and fast-track processes.
